name: Gasthof Gemse
beschreibung:
Centrally and conveniently located in Prutz, Gasthof Gemse provides traditional inn hospitality with cosy guestrooms and hearty Tyrolean dishes.

The premier ski resort Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis, the Kaunertal Glacier, and varied hiking trails are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: The traditional Gasthof Gemse in Prutz offers comfortable rooms and regional cuisine in the Tiroler Oberland.
